properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.database-schema-update
properties.description: What the engine does to its database schema on start, as Camunda's 'databaseSchemaUpdate': for example 'true', 'false' or 'create-drop'. All keys of this section work for every adapter id of type 'camunda7', not only for the id 'camunda7'.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.history-time-to-live
properties.description: The default history time to live of the engine, as an ISO 8601 period.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.data-source-name
properties.description: The name of the datasource bean the engine of this adapter id runs on.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.table-prefix
properties.description: The prefix of the engine's database tables.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.serialization-format
properties.description: The serialization format of a shared value the engine has no variable type for, for example 'application/json' or 'application/xstream'. The matching dataformat has to be on the class path. It is also read per workflow module and per workflow, and the most specific value wins: 'vanillabp.workflow-modules.<module>.workflows.<workflow>.adapters.<id>.serialization-format'.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.message-time-to-live
properties.description: How long a correlated message waits for the workflow to reach the point where it waits for it, for example '10m'. It has the key and the meaning of the Camunda 8 adapter. Not set, or zero, refuses a correlation nothing waits for where the application made the call, as in version 1. It is also read per workflow module, per workflow and per message, and the most specific value wins: 'vanillabp.workflow-modules.<module>.workflows.<workflow>.messages.<message>.adapters.<id>.message-time-to-live'.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.engine-plugins
properties.description: The Camunda engine plugins of this adapter id, keyed by a name you choose. Each one names its class in 'plugin-class' and its settings in 'properties'.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.tenant-id
properties.description: The Camunda tenant a workflow module is deployed to under the name-clash avoidance mode 'by-adapter'. Without it the workflow module id is the tenant, as in VanillaBP 1. A workflow module may name its own tenant at 'vanillabp.workflow-modules.<module>.adapters.<id>.tenant-id'.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.accept-unscoped-identifiers
properties.description: States that the identifiers of this application are unique across all its workflow modules. It silences the warning which the name-clash-avoidance mode 'none' logs per workflow module.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.allow-listeners
properties.description: Whether @WorkflowTask methods serve the execution listeners somebody modelled. Without it a model with such a listener does not start. It is also read per workflow module and per workflow, and the most specific value wins: 'vanillabp.workflow-modules.<module>.workflows.<workflow>.adapters.<id>.allow-listeners'. There is no task level.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.sleep-until-something-is-due
properties.description: Whether the job executor of this adapter id waits until the next job is due, instead of polling. Useful on a database which is billed by use.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.db-metrics-reporting
properties.description: Whether the engine writes its metrics to the database every 900 seconds. Default: the opposite of 'sleep-until-something-is-due', so a sleeping engine stops writing them.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.dmn-feel-legacy-behavior
properties.description: Whether the engine evaluates decisions with its older FEEL implementation, which needs no FEEL engine library. An application which runs the Operaton adapter next to this one needs it, together with an exclusion of 'org.camunda.feel:feel-engine'. Only the adapter level exists, because the setting belongs to the engine.
